class.name: Awakened Warrior Class
lore: Choose the Awakened Warrior Class
class.desc_es: Un guerrero despertado con una espada espiritual roja: combos brutales, saltos berserker, barreras de sangre y grietas que hacen estallar el suelo.

skills.name: Bulwark Instinct
lore: Getting hit gives you Resistance 3 for 5 seconds.
🕗 {duration}s Duration
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Pasiva: al recibir un golpe ganas Resistencia III durante 5 segundos.

skills.name: Brutal Combo
lore: Unleash a brutal chain of strikes:
- First Strike: A wide slash forward.
- Second Strike: A wide slash forward.
- Third Strike: A short forward dash and a wide pierce.
- Fourth Strike: A vertical spinning slash while taking enemies
into the air.
- Fifth Strike: A final down smash strike.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Dos tajos amplios, una estocada en carrera, un tajo giratorio que levanta a los enemigos y un golpe final hacia el suelo.

skills.name: Berserker's Leap
lore: Sweep your sword through the surface, creating a line of rupture.
Then leap up, smash down to the area you're looking at.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Arrastras la espada por el suelo abriendo una grieta; luego saltas y caes con fuerza donde miras.

skills.name: Relentless Whirlwind
lore: Execute a spinning whirlwind slash for a while. Then step back,
dash forward delivering a long-ranged pierce twice.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Un torbellino de tajos durante un rato y, después, un paso atrás y dos estocadas largas en carrera.

skills.name: Bloodbound Barrier
lore: Gather in blood aura forming a bloody barrier. Block any damage
up to 5 times. During the shield's duration, release a blood pulse
that damages nearby enemies whenever you get hit.
🗡 {damage} Damage
🕗 {duration}s Duration
⌛ {skillcooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Un aura de sangre forma una barrera que bloquea hasta 5 golpes; cada vez que te golpean suelta un pulso de sangre que hiere a los cercanos.

skills.name: Vicious Strike
lore: Stand still and gather aura, then release your rage with an
upward sweep from the surface, drawing a long line of destructive
rupture forward.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Te quedas quieto acumulando aura y sueltas tu rabia con un tajo desde el suelo que abre una larga grieta destructiva hacia delante.

skills.name: Strike of Fury
lore: Gather in vibrative aura while your red spiritual sword grows
massively in length. Then slash forward with your sword 4 times in a
row, leap up high, and smash down the area you're looking at,
creating a huge crack with ruptures. Immediately leap up and
backwards to your original position. The crack glows up and
creates a huge explosion, with bigger ruptures and rubbles
emerging and destroyed from the surface. Enemies in the area get
stunned for a while.
🗡 {damage} Damage
⌛ {cooldown}s Cooldown
skills.desc_es: Tu espada espiritual crece enormemente: cuatro tajos, un salto y un golpe que abre una gran grieta donde miras; vuelves atrás y la grieta estalla con rocas y escombros.
